hooks.command: if ! command -v devbox >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'devbox not found on PATH — install: curl -fsSL https://get.jetify.com/devbox/install.sh | bash'; exit 0; fi; if [ -f devbox.json ]; then devbox install >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi

d="$(git rev-parse --git-dir 2>/dev/null)"; [ -n "$CPLAT_RUN_PARENT" ] || [ -f "$d/cplat-ship.json" ] || [ -f "$d/cplat-app-ship.json" ] || [ -f "$d/cplat-run.json" ] || exit 0; out=$("${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/cplat" budget gate --invocation 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ $rc -eq 2 ] && printf %s "$out" | grep -q 'budget exhausted'; then printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
f="$(git rev-parse --git-dir 2>/dev/null)/cplat-ship.json"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; exec "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/cplat" ship gate
f="$(git rev-parse --git-dir 2>/dev/null)/cplat-app-ship.json"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; exec "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/cplat" app-ship gate
